entities.summary: Andrey Batt is a Russian actor, director, rapper, songwriter, composer and producer. Andrey began his career as a director at just seventeen, with the independent sports film Remix Tape (2002). In 2009, Batt began acting, appearing in commercials and TV-shows. In 2016, he performed with a halftime show at the most prestigious sports tournament in Europe, EuroLeague.
